function: MARL actors choose each beam's target cell, RB chunk and power share in LEO downlink scheduling with duplicate-request resolution (p. 3, 11).
system: Multi-shell LEO downlink: 4 shells, 16 satellites (32, 64 in scalability), 4 steerable beams each, 128 traffic cells, 20 GHz, 8 RBs of 5 MHz (p. 5, 12).
method: MAPPO with typed-node encoder using per-shell mean summaries, autoregressive actor (beam-cell, RB chunk, power Dirichlet), CTDE critic, replay-based counterfactual beam credit; online MARL in simulator (p. 10-15).
data_channel: Custom LEO simulator: circular orbits, free-space plus atmospheric loss, log-normal shadowing, blockage, scan-loss beam pattern, Poisson hotspot traffic; parameters follow 3GPP TR 38.821 ranges (p. 4, 5, 15).
test_conditions: Same simulator for training and testing; final checkpoint of 10 seeds evaluated on 100 episodes; each scalability or load point retrains a model (p. 16).
baselines: IPPO, MAPPO, MADDPG, QMIX and VDN, all learned MARL, plus ablation variants; no non-learned baseline (p. 16, 17).
metrics: Episode reward, traffic served per episode (Gbit), interference violation, excess DBR rate, post-resolution retention rate; ten-seed mean and standard deviation (p. 15, 16).
complexity: Online inference O(N[Cvis+H(R+|Shot|+4)+K(Cvis+|Z|)]), reducing to O(NKR); counterfactual replay training cost O(Bact*Creplay) (p. 13, 15).
q1_support: p. 15: "System parameters follow the range of LEO NTN reference scenarios in 3GPP TR 38.821"; the channel gain itself is the paper's own large-scale model (Eq. 9, p. 4) with log-normal shadowing and blockage. No 3GPP TR 38.811 or 38.901 channel model, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 16: "corresponds to models trained for the indicated operating condition"; p. 16: "checkpoint from each seed is evaluated over a common set of 100 episodes". Each load, RB and constellation-size point retrains a model, and testing uses the same simulator distribution.
q3_support: p. 16: "We first compare ShellMean-MAPPO with representative MARL baselines, including independent PPO (IPPO)"; p. 17: "actor-critic, and value-decomposition methods for multi-agent learning". All baselines (IPPO, MAPPO, MADDPG, QMIX, VDN) are learned; no non-learned scheduler is compared.
q4_support: p. 17: "the online inference complexity is O(NKR)". The paper also gives the full inference complexity of Eq. (89) (p. 13) and the replay training complexity (p. 15).
q5_support: p. 15: "Computer simulations evaluate the performance of ShellMean-MAPPO in a multi-shell LEO downlink scenario"; the data come from the authors' own simulator, with no link to code or data and no public dataset or measured data.
notes: Included, area 6: the learned MARL policy controls beam-cell requests, RB chunks and power shares of satellite links, which the instructions treat as physical layer; the problem is framed as downlink scheduling, so the reviewer may check it against the above_phy rule. q1: only the system parameters follow 3GPP TR 38.821 (p. 15), while the channel is the paper's own large-scale model (Eqs. 9 to 13), so the reviewer may confirm that TR 38.821 does not count. All baselines are learned MARL methods, so q3 is 0. Tables 1 to 6 were read from the PDF pages.
